title: MedNet Jordan — Medical Network (Find a Provider map)
notes: One POST to the page's own fetch endpoint (view_mode=map) from a browser session (direct requests are blocked by the F5 WAF); it returns all 3,249 providers, every one with country 'Jordan'. The feed carries only name, category and coordinates: specialty, phone and address are empty for every row (address is literally 'Jordan'), and the /ar page returns identical English-only data, so there is no name_ar. No effective date. Category DOCTOR/DENTIST rows become practitioner records unless the name contains CENTER/CENTRE/CLINIC(S)/HOSPITAL/CORNER/AIDS/COMPLEX (then clinic / dental_clinic facility). Names kept verbatim including MedNet's internal annotations such as '(POTASH ONLY)', '(NEPCO ONLY)', '(PLZ USE D5412)', '( FT )' — these mark providers restricted to specific client groups and are also copied to extra.name_annotations. MedNet's site says it administers 7 insurers in Jordan; it does not say which network tier each insurer's members get. Counts: {"hospital": 81, "practitioner": 1867, "clinic": 121, "pharmacy": 676, "dental_clinic": 61, "rehabilitation": 86, "laboratory": 226, "optician": 69, "imaging_center": 62}
